title: 评审有明确时段
premise: 解析器待评审，Lukas尚有平台工作，站会协调排期。
listeningTask: 听出评审承诺与不能提前视为完成的事项。

lines.en: The review queue is my main blocker. The change is up for review already.
lines.zh: 主要阻塞是评审队列，变更已经提交评审。

lines.en: I've got bandwidth at eleven this morning. I can't promise approval before reading it.
lines.zh: 上午十一点我有时间，但读之前不能承诺通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, eleven is review start, right? What's the ETA for initial feedback?
lines.zh: 确认一下，十一点开始评审，对吧？初次反馈预计什么时候？

lines.en: My integration branch depends on its output shape. I can still prepare the adapter tests.
lines.zh: 集成分支依赖输出结构，我仍能先准备适配器测试。

lines.en: Keep the interface description beside the change. Reviewers shouldn't reverse-engineer the expected output.
lines.zh: 变更旁放接口说明，不该让评审者反推预期输出。

lines.en: Okay, I'll add that description before eleven. Maybe ten minutes for the example outputs.
lines.zh: 好，十一点前补说明，示例输出可能需十分钟。

lines.en: Initial feedback should arrive before lunch. Larger design questions may need a separate discussion.
lines.zh: 午饭前给初次反馈，大的设计问题可能另需讨论。

lines.en: We'll circle back at the afternoon checkpoint. Don't mark the review complete before feedback.
lines.zh: 下午检查点再跟进，反馈前不标成评审完成。

lines.en: I can review test clarity in parallel. That doesn't replace Lukas's implementation review.
lines.zh: 我可并行审查测试清晰度，不能替代Lukas审实现。

lines.en: Good, I'll prepare integration fixtures meanwhile. That keeps progress moving without assuming interface approval.
lines.zh: 好，我同时准备集成fixture，不假设接口已获批准。

scene: 解析器待评审，Lukas尚有平台工作，站会协调排期。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
